title: Effects Fixer
description: Mod that allows you to use the name of the effects aswell as the IDs when using the command /effect.
body:
Effect Fixer Mod:

The "Effect Fixer" mod simplifies applying potion effects in Minecraft using commands. Admins can apply effects to players by name or ID, making it easier to manage statuses without remembering complex IDs. Ideal for servers, it supports both single-word and multi-word effect names.
Use Case 1: Single-word effect

Command:

/effect Steve speed 30 1

Applies the "Speed" effect to "Steve" for 30 seconds with an amplifier of 1.
Use Case 2: Multi-word effect

Command:

/effect Alex night_vision 60 2

Applies the "Night Vision" effect to "Alex" for 60 seconds with an amplifier of 2.

The mod streamlines potion effect commands, providing more control with fewer steps.** Only required on the server.**
